firm_data.firm_description: The Basile Law Firm P.C. is recognized in the public markets as one of the nation's foremost securities litigation firms defending small public companies in complex financial litigation across the country. The firm focuses on helping public companies unwind bad financial deals.
notable_facts: Represents numerous NASDAQ, NYSE and OTC Markets small to middle-market public companies.
Has offices in New York, Dallas Texas and Naples Florida.
Represents more public companies in convertible debt litigation than any other firm in the country.

tech_contact.name: Donna Basile
tech_contact.title: Business Manager At The Basile Law Firm P.c.

email.subject: AI for The Basile Law Firm - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Mark,

Your firm represents more public companies in convertible debt litigation than any other in the country. That level of specialization in complex securities work demands tools built for precision, not generic solutions.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the broader market to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Jericho office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
